description: NASA SDO/AIA 171 Å, 4096 px, EUV false-color snapshot. One observed hemisphere; far side reconstructed. Not a live image.
credit: NASA/SDO and the AIA science team

granulation.usage: Observed patch repeated with mirrored wrapping as an illustrative solar surface; not a full-Sun measurement.

processing: Both images encoded as 4096×4096 JPEG for delivery. Granulation sampled as luminance and mirrored across the sphere.
